A running list of shipped artifacts. Each entry links to code and, where possible, a short writeup or demo.

# Image processing
## Automated multimodal co-registration
Automated co-registration pipeline for _in vivo_ two-photon z-stacks ↔ _ex vivo_ light-sheet 3D volumes / Xenium 2D spatial transcriptomics slices, with a Qt5 QC application. <br>
- **Stack:** Python, 3D image registration, Qt5, Claude Code <br>
- **Links:** *(add repo / documentation link)*

## Crosstalk correction in beam-splitting two-photon microscopy
Decrosstalk between simultaneously imaged two-photon calcium imaging channels. <br>
- **Links:** *(add repo / documentation link)*

## Background signal contamination correction 
Correction protocol for per-cell neuropil contamination in two-photon calcium imaging data. <br>
- **Links:** *(add repo / documentation link)*

## DFF calculation for two-photon calcium imaging data
Fluorescence baseline estimation using iterative reweighted least squares (IRLS) and noise level matching, with a Qt5 QC application. <br>
- **Stack:** Python, time series, IRLS, Qt5 <br>
- **Links:** *(add repo / documentation link)*

## Single cell z-drift QC for two-photon calcium imaging data
Quantification of single cell-level z-drift in two-photon calcium imaging data. <br>
- **Stack:** Python, image registration <br>
- **Links:** *(add repo / documentation link)*


# Image acquisition
## Online motion correction
Implementing online motion correction for beam-splitting two-photon imaging, based on the observation of brain swelling during hydration. <br>
- **Stack:** MATLAB, Python, image registration <br>
- **Links:** *(add repo / documentation link)*


# Spatial transcriptomics
## Gene panel selection package for 3D spatial transcriptomics
Python package *mfishtoolspy* for gene panel selection in 3D spatial transcriptomics - a translation and extension of the R package (mFISHtools) into Python. <br>
- **Stack:** Python, R, scRNA, spatial transcriptomics, cursor AI <br>
- **Links:** *(add repo / documentation link)*

## 3D ROI Quality Classifier
LightGBM-based classifier on engineered intensity, morphology, shape, and context features, with a retraining architecture tracked in MLflow. (3D HCR ROI) <br>
- **Stack:** Python, LightGBM, MLflow, CellPose-SAM, feature engineering, human-in-the-loop retraining <br>
- **Links:** *(add repo / documentation link)*

# Behavior monitoring
## Automated pupil tracking 
Automated pupil tracking pipeline for two-photon imaging experiments.
- **Stack:** DeepLabCut, LightningPose <br>
- **Links:** *(add repo / documentation link)*

## Automated whisker-object touch detection in 3D (USC)
Object touch detection algorithm using 3D behavior monitoring data with occlusion handling. <br>
- **Stack:** MATLAB, 3D behavior monitoring <br>
- **Links:** *(add repo / documentation link)*


# Neuroscientific data analysis
## Benchmarking visual responsiveness quantification methods
Comparison of methods for quantifying visual responsiveness in neural data, proposing a more statistically robust alternative. <br>
- **Links:** *(add repo / documentation link)*

## GCaMP8 transgenic mouse line validation & characterization
Validation and characterization of new GCaMP8 transgenic mouse lines, including pan-inhibitory and soma-targeting pan-neuronal expression. <br>
- **Links:** *(add repo / documentation link)*

## Functional interaction analysis
Quantification of functional interactions between simultaneously recorded neurons. <br>
